items.name: c-time-picker-1
items.title: Inline time panel
items.description: Hour and minute columns rendered in place, with Now, Clear and a live readout.
items.descriptionLong: Inline time panel. Built by composing Card, Time Picker. A free, open source shadcn time picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-time-picker-1 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-time-picker-2
items.title: Popover picker
items.description: Outline trigger in a labelled field that opens hour and minute columns with Now, Clear and OK.
items.descriptionLong: Popover picker. Built by composing Field, Time Picker. A free, open source shadcn time picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-time-picker-2 and edit as your own code.
